stories.title: Key leaders sound the alarm on AI. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback
stories.description: Some key leaders at artificial intelligence companies call for a slowdown in AI development. And, Iran-Gulf diplomacy hits a setback as talks in Oman are delayed.

stories.title: Morning news brief
stories.description: Industry leaders call for AI development to slow down to ensure safety, Trump to campaign for GOP candidates ahead of midterms, Iranian officials say a meeting with the Gulf States has been postponed.
